Overview.Name: A. Sirisha
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Minimal non-veg, mostly vegetarian. Avoids non-veg on Monday, Thursday and Saturday.

Main_Meal: Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid soy and soy-based products completely.
Follow vegetarian options on Monday, Thursday and Saturday.
Since fried foods are a craving, prefer homemade roasted or grilled alternatives.
Morning sunlight exposure can improve energy, mood and recovery.
Yoga combined with consistent meal timing will help maintain a healthy body composition.
For stress or boredom eating, drink water first and wait 10 minutes before eating.
